coverage_rule: Every accepted and watchlist record appears exactly once. No representative-only selection is used.
line_semantics: Shared calendar and repository classification only, not paper-to-paper inheritance, causal relationships, or clinical benefit.
family_semantics: Accepted records retain their native family; watchlist records use proposed_family without altering their original metadata or review status.
time_bins: 1980–2009, 2010–2014, then one bin per year from 2015 to the latest record year (at least 2026). Older records expand the first bin instead of being omitted.
archival_selection: milestones.json retains the earlier selected examples and source warnings; it is not the full-map data source.
